F1: website_name` is not in `untrusted_attributes`, so nothing checks `restrict_user_fields?` for it, and anonymous viewers still get the host and path of a TL0 user's website.
F2: include_website_name` has no `?`, so AMS never calls it; the `website.present?` check never runs and `website_name` is always sent, as null when there is no website.
F3: model.website_name` is set only by the server, and `save` updates only `bio_excerpt`, so after editing the website the header label keeps the old value until a full reload.
